name: labs/cetuspcr__cetus-pcr
title: Cetus PCR low-cost thermocycler (functions.ArduinoPCR)
intro: Cetus PCR low-cost thermocycler (functions.ArduinoPCR), adapted from cetuspcr/cetus-pcr. It reads `sample_temperature`, `lid_temperature`, `is_running`, `current_step` and 1 more; runs `run_protocol` and `stop_peltier`. `run_protocol`: run one temperature hold step for a number of cycles through the upstream PID experiment loop; the Peltier is driven by that loop, not by a temperature setpoint of the firmware. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/cetuspcr__cetus-pcr --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/cetuspcr__cetus-pcr --backend fake --mcp
